procedural_matters: TUR 1 was represented by Zeynep Cacur (helm).
IND 14 was represented by Verma Shraddha (helm).
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
Sharma Ravindra Kumar (crew of IND 14), attended the hearing as an observer.
Lutfi Celepoven (crew of TUR 1), attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident in race 6 were 5-7 knots of wind with small chop.
TUR 1 reached the zone of mark 3p before the last reach to the finish clear ahead of IND 14 by less than one metre and a boat width to leeward of mark 3p.
At the mark TUR 1 slowed down to let an unidentified GBR boat, clear ahead of her, round the mark.
TUR 1 started luffing towards the mark.
At that moment IND 14 was clear astern of TUR 1.
IND 14 kept her course and established an overlap to windward of TUR 1 by sailing between her and the mark.
The boats were on converging courses and when the lateral distance between them was 30 cm TUR 1 bore away sharply.
IND 14 rounded the mark ahead of TUR 1.
conclusions: IND 14 to windward failed to keep clear of TUR 1 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
IND 14 not overlapped with TUR 1 and not in the zone at the time TUR 1 reached the zone, failed to give TUR 1 mark-room, and broke RRS 18.2(a)(2).
